description: Source code implementing support for reading .Z compressed files in the FreeType project, specifically handling LZW decompression logic and stream reading.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_refill
methods.description: Refills the LZW stream buffer from the source stream.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_get_code
methods.description: Retrieves the next code from the LZW stream buffer.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_stack_grow
methods.description: Grows the character stack for LZW decompression.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_prefix_grow
methods.description: Grows the prefix and suffix arrays used in LZW decompression.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_reset
methods.description: Resets the LZW state to initial conditions.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_init
methods.description: Initializes the LZW state with a source stream.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_done
methods.description: Frees resources and cleans up the LZW state.

methods.name: ft_lzwstate_io
methods.description: Performs LZW decompression and outputs data into a buffer.
